name: Hotaka Ayano
source:
Ayano got possesed by a ghost as soon as she joined the school, which caused cat ears to grow on her head.
She's a very carefree girl that can be a bit of an airhead.
Back in her hometown she didn't have many friends because of her timid personality. In order to change this situation, she moved and enrolled to Kuji Academy.
She loves reading to the point she gets so absorbed she forgets about her surroundings.
